properties.name: A read of a held design is as true as a read of the live one: the copy rebuilds its search index, carries its version stamp, and reads everything else where the design lives
properties.rationale:
ROOT CAUSE (fact:root-cause-a-held-design-answers-search-through-the-door-with-a-false-nothing-matched-2026-10-02, confirmed on main d9e2a8f): snapshot_dir skipped the store's only nested directory, the full-text index, under a comment that said not to use a snapshot for search_design; the door then used it for every read-only tool, and Tantivy creates an empty index where none exists. Measuring the class (fact:a-held-reads-copy-also-lacked-the-designs-location-and-its-version-stamp-2026-10-02) found three more things the copy lacked: the design's location, the records beside the store, and the version stamp.

THE FIX IS AT THE CAUSE, not per tool. (1) The index guarantee moved into the OPEN (DesignGraph::open_rocksdb compares the index's count with the store's searchable nodes and rebuilds on any difference), so every source and every consumer is covered: search_design, topic_report, and the capture guard inside seven constructors. A rebuild was chosen over copying the index, because a copy can catch a segment mid-commit, and over refusing index-backed tools, because rebuilding is how the live server already builds it at start. Cost, measured on reflow2's own design (5,751 searchable nodes, debug build): a held --call read 2.4 s → 5.7 s; a free one unchanged; --export-snapshot 8.0 s → 11.1 s. (2) The floor: StorageEngine::search_fulltext checks an EMPTY result against the store and refuses when the index does not cover it, so nothing matched is never answered from an index that holds less than the store. (3) ReflowService::reading_a_copy serves the copy as the design at its real path, with writes_beside_store false, so sidecar reads are the design's and sidecar writes (usage ledger, handshake record, sync record and its observations) are suppressed. (4) The copy carries .meta.json, and a copy that fails part-way is removed (fact:a-held-reads-copy-that-failed-part-way-was-left-in-the-temp-dir-2026-10-03, found by CI on this change); a file the holder deletes between the listing and the copy is skipped. (5) searched on search_design and topic_report, and a third pass in tools/empty_speaks.py, which missed this because it never asked a query-taking read anything.

NOT DONE, deliberately: routing a held read through the holder (dec:idea-a-one-shot-call-reaches-the-design-where-it-is-served) stays open; this fix does not foreclose it. --export-snapshot pays the rebuild though it does not search; an open path that skips the guarantee would re-create the class for a later caller.

FOUR OLDER OPEN DEFECTS ARE RECORDED AGAINST FILES THIS CHANGE TOUCHED, and it fixed none of them: fact:a-local-feature-error-was-worked-around-instead-of-read-as-the-ci-contract (search.rs), fact:closure-was-one-question-with-two-answers-so-a-refuted-finding-read-as-current-on-the-surface-a-person-meets-first (search), fact:a-measurement-recorded-only-as-prose-is-one-nothing-can-close-and-it-produced-a-wrong-plan (the sync check), fact:a-hub-attached-to-a-child-server-started-without-export-to-and-its-writes-went-unexported-2026-09-22 (the export write-through). detect_gaps asks of each whether this repair was its fix; the answer is no. The gaps are left open: acknowledging one settles intent, which waits for the owner's word.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: While another process holds a design, --call answers a read-only tool from a copy of its store. The copy now rebuilds its search index from the copied nodes, carries the version stamp, and is served as the design at its real path, so the project tree and the records beside the store are read there and none of them is written. Any store opened with a search index that does not hold what the store holds rebuilds it, and loop_status reports that once. search_design and topic_report say how many nodes they searched, and a search that would answer nothing matched from an index that does not cover its store refuses instead.
